purpose:
Local-host (WOOD-GAME-MAIN, RTX 5080 16GB, ComfyUI 0.34.0) run of the two-character
    IP-Adapter regional identity matrix (c1..c6, seed 1001) across all local SDXL-family
    checkpoints that support the IP-Adapter PLUS FACE mechanism. Answers: which local SDXL
    models hold two distinct character identities (Dean left / Becky right) from image
    references via regional IP-Adapter? FLUX.1-dev fp8 is EXCLUDED - it is not SDXL and has no
    IP-Adapter PLUS FACE path.
runnerNote:
Added --checkpoint CLI override (default remains juggernautXL_ragnarok.safetensors) so the
    committed matrix runner can target any checkpoint served by the host. Backward compatible.
mechanism: IP-Adapter PLUS FACE (portraits), regional attn_mask per character

pony.support: IP-Adapter PLUS FACE (mechanism loads, distribution off-model)

flux.support: NONE - not SDXL, excluded from IP-Adapter

juggernaut.note:
All 6 cells photoreal, Dean holds identity on left (brown hair, blue shirt, watch),
        Becky on right (brown updo, striped tank, freckles). Consistent across c1-c6. Baseline model.

biglust.note:
All 6 cells photoreal and on-model. Dean holds identity incl. forearm tattoo (c1/c2),
        Becky holds identity (striped tank, freckles). Strongest tattoo-fidelity of the local SDXL set.

pony.note:
Mechanism loads and queues, but output drifts to Pony's stylized/anime distribution
        (no score tags in the photoreal Juggernaut-tuned matrix prompts -> wrong distribution).
        Dean/Becky identity NOT held; some cells surreal/off-composition. Pony requires its own
        score-tagged prompt style, out of scope of the photoreal matrix suite. No Pony images committed.
